summary: Iteration 6 (CognitionExpander port) FULL PASS. All 8 new backend endpoints work: /memory/recall (scored+sorted desc, no _id leak), /memory/concepts (clusters sorted by count desc), /cognition/threads POST/GET(active_only)/DELETE/POST tick (iterations increment, 410 on inactive thread, high-novelty insight persisted as Memory with tags ['insight','thread:<prefix>']), /observe/suggest (http/https url + reason), /brain/snapshot (version+exported_at+memories+threads, no _id), /brain/restore (replace wipes, merge appends). 27/27 pytest tests pass (12 new + 15 regression). Frontend slash commands verified end-to-end: /help shows expanded list including /think /threads /recall /concepts /suggest /export-brain; /think prints [THREAD-SPAWN]; /threads lists active; /stop-thread <prefix> prints [THREAD-HALT]; /recall prints [RECALL N matches for "q"] with score percentages; /concepts prints [CONCEPTS N clusters across M memories]; /suggest prints [SUGGEST-WATCH <url>] and auto-flips center tab to observe with iframe loaded; /export-brain triggers Blob download with no console errors. MemoryDrawer has memory-export-btn / memory-import-label / memory-import-input — all clickable without throwing. 30s autonomous tick polling useEffect is wired (verified in code; runs GET /cognition/threads + POST /tick per active thread, surfaces [INSIGHT] when novelty>=0.7). Regression on prior commands (/memory /remember /forget /clear-memory /watch /stop-watch /speak /capabilities) is green; map, neural lattice, observation iframe, permissions panel unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~820 lines. With 4 feature areas added, time to split into routers (chat.py, memory.py, observe.py, cognition.py, brain.py). Still readable but approaching the 700-line guideline.

/cognition/threads/{id}/tick performs a Claude call inline (2-4s) and the frontend's 30s polling loop fires one POST per active thread serially. If the operator spawns many threads this becomes a long blocking window in the browser. Consider Promise.all + per-thread last_tick throttling on the backend (skip if last_tick < 25s ago) to make this safe at scale.

Insight memories created on novelty>=0.7 use tag 'thread:<id-prefix>' (8 chars). Two threads whose UUIDs collide in the first 8 chars (cosmic-low odds) would share a tag — non-blocking but worth noting.

/brain/restore does no schema validation on the supplied memories/threads (any dict shape is accepted). Acceptable for a personal external-brain feature, but a malformed import could insert documents missing required fields and cause downstream serialization errors when GET /memory tries to coerce timestamp. Consider validating with the Memory/CognitionThread pydantic models before insert_many.

Recall scoring is a simple keyword-frequency heuristic (hits/terms/3 + tag bonus). Works fine; the spec called it 'semantic' but it's lexical. Real semantic recall would require an embedding store — out of scope for this iteration but flag for future work.
Frontend /export-brain uses URL.createObjectURL but never URL.revokeObjectURL — minor memory leak if the operator exports many times in one session.

rca_of_the_issue: No issues. Initial Playwright run flagged /recall and /concepts as failing because the test regex \[RECALL \d+ matches?\] expected the closing bracket immediately after the digit, but the actual (correct) frontend format is '[RECALL 6 matches for "althea"]'. After loosening the regex to \[RECALL\s+\d+\s+match the assertions pass — features themselves are working correctly.
